test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the appropriate option to complete the sentence:

So delicate ___ the negotiations that a single leak could have ruined them.
solution:
The correct answer is '**were**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb form must agree with the plural subject "**negotiations**", so the plural auxiliary "**were**" is required.
 
• The pattern used here is an inversion: "**So + adjective + auxiliary + subject**" (So delicate **were** the negotiations...).
 
• The clause "**could have ruined**" indicates a past possibility, so a past form ("were") fits the time reference of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"So delicate **were**__ the negotiations that a single leak could have ruined them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "are"** is incorrect because it is present tense, while the sentence context ("could have ruined") refers to a past situation.
 
• **Option 3: "was"** is singular, but the subject "negotiations" is plural, so subject–verb agreement is violated.
 
• **Option 4: "is"** is also present tense and does not match the implied past conditional idea in the rest of the sentence.
